title: Resposta observável por eixo e sentido, pulso nativo

scope.mode: ONVIF ContinuousMove com watchdog nativo do Toposync

safety.manual_stop: Only the finally backstop after an interruption before return.
safety.preset_policy: Preserve the temporary preset whenever quiet visual return is not verified.

gate.response: verified visual displacement at least 2 analysis pixels
gate.recovery: five-frame quiet visual return with overlap at least 0.85 and displacement at most 15 analysis pixels
gate.interpretation: These seeds establish bounded observability only. Repeatability and correction precision require a later, separately declared batch.

pause.reason: The negative-pan trial showed an observable response but its quiet post-return view differed from baseline by 30.8128 analysis pixels, beyond the 15-pixel gate.
pause.preserved_reference: A named temporary preset remains on the camera for deliberate recovery.
pause.required_before_remaining_trials: Resolve and visually confirm the recovery reference, then create a new manifest with a distinct recovery hypothesis.
